rationale: Build, blood pressure, lipids, A1c, tobacco, family history, occupation, liver and financials all carry zero debits; the only charge is the 2025 DUI conviction. The manual refers a recent motoring conviction to judgement and no referral is available, so I used judgement. A conviction this recent, consistent with the nearest precedent (2024 DUI, postponed), is postponed until more time has elapsed rather than rated Table 2 on 50 debits.
